simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹמֶט (H2546) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: חֹמֶט (chômeṭ) means a lizard (as creeping) First listed occurrence: Lev 11 30.

definitions.full: H2546. chomet חֹ֫מֶט noun [masculine] a kind of lizard , only in list of unclean creeping animals Lev 11:30 ׃ וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהָאֲנָקָה (Aramaic is chameleon ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning, to lie low;
